value: Responding to an open letter advocating a 6-month pause on AI training more powerful than GPT-4, this article argues such a measure is woefully inadequate. The author contends that the development of unaligned superhuman AI, rather than merely "human-competitive" intelligence, poses an immediate and catastrophic existential threat, likely leading to global human extinction due to a lack of control and understanding. Asserting that current safety research is virtually nonexistent and far outpaced by capability advancements, the author proposes an urgent, indefinite, and globally enforced moratorium on all large AI training runs—including the shutdown of GPU clusters and drastic enforcement against non-compliance—as the only viable path to prevent humanity's demise.
